Hello dear

Welcome To Gostilna in pizzerija Jurman

Gostilna in pizzerija Jurman is a well-established dining spot located on Zaloska cesta in Ljubljana, known for its extensive menu and generous portions. The restaurant offers a diverse selection ranging from traditional Slovenian dishes to pizzas, making it a favorite among locals. Guests appreciate the fresh, delicious food and friendly service, with highlight dishes including the seafood platter and their signature "Jurmančinke." The relaxing atmosphere and ample seating ensure a welcoming experience, even during peak hours. While prices may lean toward the higher side, the quality and value offered consistently garner praise, making it a go-to destination for both casual diners and families.

People talk

Our Guestbook

“ A large restaurant with a long tradition along one of the major streets in Ljubljana. The food is okay and the portions are large, but the prices are somewhat steep for this part of town. They have a lot of parking space and a lot of sitting room, so there's usually no need to reserve a table. A selection of lunch menus is served daily, but they also have a large a la carte menu if nothing strikes your fancy. ”

- Gregor Šinkovec

“ We had a great night at this place. We ordered the fish, seafood platter, schnitzel, and mixed vegetable salad — everything was absolutely delicious. Our waiter, Akif, was incredibly helpful and friendly; we felt genuinely welcomed and well looked after. The atmosphere was relaxed and inviting, and the prices were very reasonable considering the quality of the food. Definitely a spot we’d recommend and would love to come back to! ”

- Sena T

“ We ate pancakes at Gostilna Jurman — the regular ones and their special “Jurmančinke” and burgers— and they were absolutely delicious! Everything was freshly made, perfectly sweet, and so satisfying that I could honestly eat them every week. Definitely a 10/10 experience! ”

- Ariana Beganovic

“ All the traditional food you can find, quality, quantity, service, decoration! Really great place , with a cool and de contracted atmosphere Dessert top ”

- Lixio gz

“ excellent food, value for money, good atmosphere. very generous portions. kids can share one burger ”

- Péter Kerekes

“ Very very good food, we did not wait long although the place was full, service great and the atmosphere, as well. Animals friendly. I do recommend the place if you are hungry and want to eat well. ”

- Sonja Leskovar

“ Average at best - disappointing! Service: polite, waiter was quick to ask what we'd like to drink, but failed to understand that drinks go with the food. Later on, he forgot to bring the ordered drinks until after the food has already been served. We were also waiting to get the bill. Food: Mushrooms soup was acceptable, but served too cold. Beefsteaks in peppersauce were as they were supposed to be, soft, tender meat, juicy. Perfectly done - medium, as requested. If it wasn't for the vegetables and potatoes (read below)... nevertheless, 4 points! Tagliatta, on the other hand, was a completely different story. The meat chosen was supposed to be roast beef. Supposed to be... we all were convinced that it wasn't. Normally, roast beef should literally melt in your mouth, meat should have been soft and tender. In reality, meat was unseasoned, dry, overcooked, almost tastless. All 3 ordered steaks were supposed to be done medium. In reality, they were almost well done. Worst thing: when served, the food was already COMPLETELY COLD - obviously, it was placed on a cold plates! I've sent mine back to the kitchen... Vegetables as a sidedish were unimaginative, only carrots, pumpkins and 1 small cherry tomato. They have also used pre-prepared frozen potatoes, defrosted and baken. Also disappointing. Tagliatta was a waste of time and money! 0 points! Additional minus: when asked for a pepper mill, the response was there was none available! ”

- Andrej Gusel

“ Abundant portions, great recipes and great cuisine. Nice affordable prices. Reservations recommended Still great service and food, enormous portions, really big. Desserts perfect ”

- Josip Miani - Pipi

About

Gostilna in pizzerija Jurman

Welcome to Gostilna in pizzerija Jurman, a culinary gem nestled along the vibrant Zaloska cesta in the heart of Ljubljana, Slovenia. With a rich tradition that spans many years, this spacious restaurant is well-equipped to cater to a diverse clientele, offering ample parking and seating options, ensuring you'll find yourself comfortably accommodated even during peak hours.

As you step inside, the inviting atmosphere sets the stage for a memorable dining experience. From my exploration of the menu, it's clear that Jurman emphasizes quality and generosity in their portions. Whether you're stopping by for one of their daily lunch specials or indulging in their extensive à la carte options, there’s something here to satisfy every palate.

During my visit, I was particularly impressed by the variety of dishes that showcase both local flavors and international favorites. The seafood platter caught my eye – featuring impeccably cooked fish and an array of fresh seafood, it was a feast for the senses. Additionally, the schnitzel received rave reviews from fellow diners, earning a reputation for its crispiness and rich flavor.

For those with a sweet tooth, don't miss the dessert offerings, which promise a delightful conclusion to your meal. One patron mentioned the “Jurmančinke,” their special pancakes that are perfectly sweet and utterly satisfying, making them a must-try item. The emphasis on fresh ingredients is evident in every bite, leaving diners craving more.

The warm service complements the delicious food. Guests have consistently praised the friendly staff, who create a welcoming environment that enhances the overall dining experience. With such a strong focus on customer service and food quality, it’s no wonder that Gostilna in pizzerija Jurman comes highly recommended by past visitors.

In conclusion, Gostilna in pizzerija Jurman is more than just a restaurant; it’s a gathering place where traditions meet modern dining. Whether you're seated with family, friends, or embarking on a solo culinary adventure, this establishment promises memorable meals that leave a lasting impression. Don't miss your chance to experience the flavors and atmosphere that make this spot a beloved part of Ljubljana's dining scene!
